types.name: FTestReport
types.doc:
The verdict sink a test reports into. A case reports pass/fail once, or
that it could not run (a fixture it does not own is gone, the device lacks
a feature): a skip names what is therefore uncovered instead of reading as
a pass or a permanently red case. FTestCase turns the state into doctest
checks when the case ends; a process whose cases skipped and none failed
exits 77.

members.name: ExitCode
members.doc:
0 when all passed or none ran, 1 when any failed, 77 when nothing
failed but something skipped.

types.name: FTestCaseOptions
types.doc:
What a case needs from its run beyond its body: the switches its host reads
(applied by FTestCase before the body runs, so `<exe> -tc=<name>` alone
reproduces a row), and what `mbt test` must prepare (a backend fan-out, a
package, a loose module, compiled material shaders).

types.name: FTestCase
types.doc:
The bracket around a case body: Begin resets the report, applies the case's
switches to FCommandLine and refuses a case gated to another OS; Conclude
turns the report into doctest checks.

members.name: ApplyFixtureProjectConsoleVariables
members.doc:
The fixture project's Config/DefaultEngine.ini [ConsoleVariables], at
project-setting priority: every case runs with the switches the
TestProject turns on (global illumination, ray tracing, ...), the way
the editor and the player see them once that project is open. Begin
applies it; a case that changed a switch calls it again to restore.

members.name: SpawnAndStream
members.signature: static int32_t SpawnAndStream(const std::string& exe, const std::vector<std::string>& args, const std::string& workDir, int32_t timeoutSeconds, std::string* captured)
members.doc:
Spawns a process with its output streamed to ours (and appended to
captured when given), killing the tree past timeoutSeconds.

members.name: TestRunDir
members.doc:
This process's own directory under <temp>/MowoTests/Runs, named by its
process id: what the engine would write to the user's Saved tree (logs,
crash reports, save games, net recordings) goes to Saved/ under it.
Per process, because lanes and shards run the same cases at once, and
a case that counts the reports it caused must not count another's.

members.name: TestCrashDir
members.doc:
Where this process and every crash probe it spawns write their reports:
--crash-test-dir when given, else TestRunDir()/Crashes. Never the user's
own Saved/Crashes, whose next launch would upload a probe's deliberate
dump as a real crash.

members.name: PruneRunDirs
members.doc: Removes run directories older than maxAgeHours whose process is gone.

members.name: RepoRoot
members.doc:
The checkout this binary was built from: --repo-root when given, else
the first ancestor of the executable that holds Engine/Source.
